pullRequests.author: llesieur99
pullRequests.head: codex/us-sub200-levels-20261105
pullRequests.body:
Summary
Match 135 NTSC-U-only level functions smaller than 200 bytes in plain C. They account for 15,100 distinct function-body bytes and 1,926 placements across the 51 NTSC-U level programs. The latest batch adds 13 functions present in 13 level placements; all 13 were checked before one complete 54-target build. Sources use inherited file flags, external globals and the existing native level naming convention. This is a tranche of the remaining small-function catalogue, not a claim that every…

pullRequests.title: feat: names, shared layouts and hero/camera matches from open-rac-engine
pullRequests.author: manstie
pullRequests.head: open-rac-engine
pullRequests.body:
Names, shared layouts and matches from open-rac-engine (GPL-3.0-or-later; facts only, credited in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md), a Rust re-implementation of Ratchet's hero, cameras and guns built from reverse-engineering R&C3 PAL and UYA NTSC-U Veldin. Draft: the plan below is to match every function it names.
Functions
All plain C, in src/levels/shared/ (claimed in #3):

L01_003E3930.c: camera_set_distance, camera_set_height, camera_no_push_back, camera_look_blend_on, camera_lock_stick,…

The latest wave adds three functions (328 body bytes, 18 placements): two multiplayer menu wrappers and a 96-byte table scan present in 16 levels. The table scan keeps the table base separate from its three-word slot offset to reproduce stock compiler…

Two already matched multiplayer functions now declare their actual scalar globals with the documented .data address attribute instead of oversized array views. Their linked bytes remain exact in all 33 existing…

pullRequests.title: match(us): two short shared level functions across 85 placements
pullRequests.author: llesieur99
pullRequests.head: codex/us-sub200-wave21-20261106
pullRequests.body:
NTSC-U matches

func_L01_0034B8A8: 120 bytes, 51 level placements.
func_L01_0045FD70: 184 bytes, 34 level placements.

Both use plain C and the inherited file flags. No flag override, alias, game asset, or private path is added. The independent store order in C reproduces the stock SN compiler's retail scheduling.
Validation

Stock native checks: MATCH for both functions.
Resolved relocation proof: all 85 placements exact, with no masked words.
Full SCUS_973.53 build: 54 of 54 targets…
